0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_000
0.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! It's a pleasure to cross paths with you again.

5.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_010
5.description: My journey continues, thanks to you and Kupopo. After my return to reality, I took to the road in search of fresh perspectives, and I've found plenty of them here in Radz-at-Han.

6.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_011
6.description: This city fascinates me to no end... Life flourishes in every color, and my imagination has grown all the richer for it!

7.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_012
7.description: I plan to roam Thavnair for a time and aid those in need along the way. If I can make a positive difference in this world with my pictomancy─just as you and our predecessors have─then it will all be worth it.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_020
8.description: As you well know, we pictomancers are wielders of the imagination, rendering our wildest dreams into reality with a magicked brush.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_021
9.description: The origins of pictomancy can be traced back to the Fifth Astral Era, when a young woman named Relm began weaving aether into her works of art.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_022
10.description: Relm was a selfless soul and refused to stand idly by as the War of the Magi raged on. She saved a great many lives on her travels, and earned the title of Archon for her deeds.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFRPM_00863_BERURU_000_023
11.description: As her disciples, it is our duty to wander this star and shine the light of hope for those in need.
